purpose: Freeze the smallest fail-closed path from the accepted LR3e-5 step-6 native checkpoint through complete BF16 export, synthetic GPU reload, non-scored development serving and persistent serving parity. This does not select the checkpoint or authorize evaluation.

offline_validation.desktop_tensor_suite_not_run_reason: The desktop environment does not provide torch and the exact pinned training image is not locally cached. The unchanged exporter has prior real-Qwen3.8 acceptance evidence; the live pinned-image CPU and GPU checks remain mandatory.

live_gates_remaining: Refresh Nebius access and recheck that the exact source seal is unchanged and both export destinations are absent.
Run one CPU-only create-once export with the pinned training image, then independently validate its self-digest, complete BF16 tensor layout, exact sidecars and unchanged source.
Run one CPU-only meta-loader check and preserve its digest-valid receipt outside the immutable export.

Preview and submit at most one c1/q1 one-GPU development synthetic reload through the Jobs API, validate finite forward and two-token generation with zero optimizer updates, then prove terminal release.

Fill the development serving template only from the accepted export, GPU check, current base registration and observed dev SFS identity; run one bounded non-scored SGLang canary and independently accept its release evidence.
Create-once stage the exact accepted export into observed inference storage, rehash it there, then prepare and preview the persistent registration from measured staging evidence.
Register only after development acceptance, wait for completion, and prove matched base/candidate engine, parser, context, decoding, model bytes and live-route behavior before any benchmark attempt.
limitations: This package is an offline operation plan and set of fail-closed templates, not evidence that any new artifact or endpoint exists.
The source is a planned pause at step 6 of a 76-step arm; it is not a completed hyperparameter arm and has not been selected by a Fleet development outcome.
The synthetic GPU check proves loadability only; the separate development serving canary and persistent live-parity gates remain mandatory.
WebExploitBench remains sealed evaluation-only and cannot select this checkpoint, recipe, retry or stopping rule.
